mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, reducing glyburide metabolism and increasing hypoglycemic risk; additionally, eslicarbazepine may have independent hyperglycemic effects through metabolic interference.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and consider alternative antiepileptic or increase glyburide dose if needed; HbA1c monitoring recommended due to potential loss of glycemic control.
